title: Pyar Ki Takkar (dub) (aranmanai Kaavalan -Tamil)
desc: A large family returns to an ancestral property (palace) to sell it off. Meanwhile they discover some supernatural elements in the palace.

title: Maidan E Jung
desc: Arjun learns that his sister loves a man who is about to get married and makes efforts to unite them. But when he learns that his sister's in-laws plan to kill her, he sets out to teach them a lesson.

title: Lucky-No Time For Love
desc: A story of Lucky, a yound girl who is taken in by a wealthy family in Russia after being orphaned in war-torn Afghanistan . While adapting to her new surroundings, she meets a man who is initially distant and unapproachable, but eventually spend more time together and form a deep bond. Despite facing cultural differences and other obstacles, their love perseveres as they strive to be together.

title: Sun Zara
desc: Trisha is mesmerised by aspiring singer Rohit's voice. After the two fall in love, Trisha meets with an accident and loses her eyesight.

title: Tada
desc: This story revolves around Balraj Rana who lost his father to the underworld mafia, and now himself dons the mantle of a dreaded gangster.
